label: Engaged Peruvian socialist tradition while centering autonomous feminist citizenship
description: Emerging from Peru’s critical left, Vargas challenged class-reductionist politics by theorizing women’s autonomous democratic mobilization.
dialecticalTension: Transforms Peruvian socialist critique into pluralist feminist democracy.
historicalContext: Flora Tristán Center & Peruvian feminist movement (1979–2000s).
